Jamie —

Welcome! Short checklist so procurement can move forward. Ive attached our vendor onboarding checklist as a PDF (see attachments). Please return the items below; once therere in and verified our AP team will issue a PO (typically within 2-3 business days).

Required evidence (minimums):
- General Liability (GL): $1,000,000 per occurrence, $2,000,000 aggregate; Redwood Inference, Inc. listed as certificate holder and additional insured per standard space.
- Errors & Omissions (E&O): $1,000,000 per claim.
- Cyber / Network Security Liability: $1,000,000 with retroactive date covering prior acts.
- W-9 (signed) or DocuSign version.
- W-9 / bank info for ACH remit (remit to ap@redwood.ai).

Optional but helpful: W-9 signed with EIN matching the payee name, W-8 if applicable, and a copy of PO routing contact. If you have a broker/insurer contact, we can reach out for certificate confirmation.

Attachment notes: we accept PDF stubs for COIs. Please include policy numbers and effective/expiration dates. If you expect the carrier to email certificates directly, forward that email to ap@redwood.ai and cc me.

PO and invoicing process:
- After verification we will issue a PO number and send a copy to your contracts email.
- Invoices should reference the PO number, include remit info, and be sent to ap@redwood.ai.
- Standard net-30 unless otherwise agreed in contract.

Im copying Monica (procurement lead) and Laura (finance) to expedite verification. If anything looks like it needs a legal review well loop in contracts.

Best,
Markus Klein
Head of Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_vendor_onboarding_checklist.pdf
